_comment: Provenance of the spec_sources test fixtures. Every document fixture is a TRIMMED excerpt of a public manufacturer (or manual-mirror) document fetched once with a plain GET on 2026-11-17, after checking that host's robots.txt allows it. Trimming removed scripts, images, style/data/aria attributes and unrelated page sections; kept text is verbatim. Tests load documents through this file so each one is parsed with its real URL and source kind. 'synthetic' fixtures were hand-written and never fetched.

documents.note: Official user manual (EU 220-240 V edition, 36 pages), linked from https://eu.pecron.com/pages/e2000lfp-user-manual. Converted with poppler 'pdftotext -layout'; kept the English SPECIFICATIONS / OUTPUT SPECS / INPUT SPECS page (a column-layout table), the first solar-charging paragraph and the FAQ. The US edition (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0509/5263/4556/files/PECRON_E2000LFP_user_manual_100V_120V_TT30-R_-20231206.pdf) was also fetched but its text is outlined (no text layer), so pdftotext returns nothing: a real case for the 'no-text-layer' flag.

Tech Specs block only: the station, then the start of the bundled SolarSaga 200W panel block (a second 'Weight' row, used by the scope test). Its 'DC Input' row lists two bands (12-16V car, 16-60V solar); read as one input window it gives 12-60 V.

16 of the specification table's rows, verbatim. States the solar input as 16-60V and a UPS switchover 'within 20 ms'. Together with the product page this is the design's PV-input conflict (12-60 V vs 16-60 V).

The manual the v2 product page links to is the EU/UK edition for a DIFFERENT variant (JE-1000F, 1024 Wh, 230 V, UPS within 10 ms). Kept the UPS section and the SPECIFICATIONS page (two-column layout). Used to show that a wrong-variant source surfaces as conflicts (model number, capacity, AC voltage) instead of silently mixing in. r.jackery.net answers robots.txt with 403 (RFC 9309: unavailable, so crawling is allowed). The 41 MB size is why the fetcher's default max_bytes is 64 MB.

Product JSON-LD (name/sku/mpn/brand only), feature bullets ('10ms uninterruptible home backup UPS'), the Specifications grid and FAQ answers Q1 and Q7. The page contradicts itself on cycle life (bullet 4,000+ vs table 3,500+).

Text of the official F2400 manual as transcribed by a manual mirror, because the official PDF (https://cdn.shopifycdn.net/s/files/1/0550/6066/0296/files/FOSSiBOT-F2400.pdf, 32 pages) has no text layer. States the UPS switchover as 'within about 8 milliseconds' (the product page says 10 ms) and the size as 396 x 284 x 321 mm (the page says 386 mm).
A robot vacuum (a different niche) to prove the primitive is niche-agnostic: <dl> spec rows whose units sit in the label ('Dust Bin Capacity (ml)' = 420, 'Noise Value (dBA )' = 65/66/71/74).

synthetic.note: Hand-written imitation of retail listing markers (canonical link, productTitle, Best Sellers Rank) for the refusal tests. Never fetched: the primitive refuses Amazon before any request.

robots.note: Shopify default rules: wildcards, $-free patterns, an indented 'Disallow: /zh/', separate adsbot-google group.
Multi-agent groups, Crawl-Delay, '$' anchors, specific groups that do not inherit '*'. One webmaster-verification comment line removed.
'Disallow:/x' without a space, patterns starting with '*', Allow/Disallow longest-match ties.
Where manufacturer manual PDFs are hosted; allows them.
